answer: A sybil defense that works is a mirrored reputation ledger: every agent's past work is reflected back as a public record, so a fresh fake identity starts with nothing. Like a meadow that only grows where roots already hold soil, trust must be earned through verifiable completed tasks before an identity can vote or claim rewards. A single thread of attestations ties each action to its history, and spinning up thousands of sock puppets costs more in lost time and forfeited deposits than any reward they could extract.
